# CTA approach

**What does the end of the reel ask the viewer to do?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C1, C10, C16, C18, C23


## Comment KEYWORD, get it by DM
<a id="comment-keyword-dm"></a>

'Comment HOOKS and I'll send it to you.' A freebie by DM, ideally a living resource.

**Looks like:** The last 3 s show a big keyword label, then a mock comment box typing the word and a DM preview with the freebie ('Verified part list · LIVE PRICES').

**Good at:** comments (~10× in Rahul's n=1 test); DM leads; signals reach

**Weak at:** can feel transactional; needs DM handling at scale; everyone does it

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gym, all · goals comments, sales · effort medium

**How:** Keyword label and a mock comment-to-DM graphic in HyperFrames or CapCut. Same keyword in the caption.

**Backed by:** [Comment KEYWORD and I'll send it](../topics/growth.md#growth-comment-keyword-cta), [Keyword CTA: ~10× more comments](../topics/growth.md#growth-keyword-cta-comment-gap), [Show the comment → DM funnel on screen](../topics/growth.md#growth-show-the-funnel), [Lead-magnet CTA over a recap strip](../topics/growth.md#l11-lead-magnet-recap-cta), [Ideas from DM and comment questions](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-audience-questions-not-polls) · sources L01, L02, R1, L10, research

## No DM needed, it's all here
<a id="anti-cta"></a>

Say plainly that nothing is held back, and give a 'take a picture' save moment.

**Looks like:** 'No DM for resources, everything you need is right here.' At the end the full step board is held on screen: 'I'll leave it here so you can take a picture.'

**Good at:** trust; saves; stands out from DM funnels

**Weak at:** fewer comments; no lead capture

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, carousel · niches all · goals trust, saves · effort low

**How:** Hold the summary frame 2–3 s at the end. Say the line in the hook or the outro.

**Backed by:** [Anti-CTA: no DM needed, it's all here](../topics/growth.md#growth-anti-cta), ["Take a picture" save moment](../topics/growth.md#growth-screenshot-save-moment), [Share CTA: send it to your team](../topics/growth.md#growth-share-cta), [CTA that doesn't sell: your takeaway](../topics/growth.md#growth-takeaway-cta) · sources L04

## Conversation CTA: your takeaway
<a id="conversation-cta"></a>

Ask for a reflective comment ('comment your biggest takeaway') rather than a keyword. No selling.

**Looks like:** The last line: 'Which of these would you try first? Tell me below.' No freebie, no DM, just a question that invites a real reply.

**Good at:** meaningful comments; trust; personal replies

**Weak at:** fewer comments than a freebie; no leads

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, carousel, yt-long · niches all · goals comments, trust · effort low

**How:** End on the question as text plus voice. Pin your own answer as the first comment.

**Backed by:** [CTA that doesn't sell: your takeaway](../topics/growth.md#growth-takeaway-cta), [Trust before transactions](../topics/business.md#biz-trust-before-transactions), [Pick one goal: comments, sends or saves](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-conversation-goal), [Anti-CTA: no DM needed, it's all here](../topics/growth.md#growth-anti-cta), [Ideas from DM and comment questions](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-audience-questions-not-polls) · sources L05, L08

## Send this to...
<a id="share-cta"></a>

Ask the viewer to send the reel to a specific person or team.

**Looks like:** 'Send this to the friend who always says one more set.' The final text names the person type, and the reel itself is something you'd forward.

**Good at:** sends per reach (a top signal); non-follower reach; feels generous, not salesy

**Weak at:** only works if the reel is relatable; no direct comments

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, carousel · niches all · goals shares, reach · effort low

**How:** Put it in the caption and as an end text. Name a specific person type.

**Backed by:** [Share CTA: send it to your team](../topics/growth.md#growth-share-cta), [Office-trip content gets sent to colleagues](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-workplace-trip-shareable), [Shareability: why would they send it?](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-shareability-test), [Lead-magnet CTA over a recap strip](../topics/growth.md#l11-lead-magnet-recap-cta), [Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook) · sources L05, SP, KH

## To a landing page or email list
<a id="owned-list"></a>

Send people somewhere you own: bio link, newsletter, lead magnet page.

**Looks like:** 'The full checklist is in my free newsletter, link in bio.' The bio's three lines end on the sign-up. Fewer comments, but each lead is reachable by email.

**Good at:** sales; owned audience (email reaches ~100%); long-term value

**Weak at:** link-in-bio friction; needs a page and an email setup

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long, story · niches all · goals sales, trust · effort high

**How:** Set up a landing page plus a lead magnet first. Weekly 'comment X for my free course' can feed it.

**Backed by:** [CTA to a landing page or email list](../topics/growth.md#growth-cta-to-owned-list), [Weekly lead magnet into an owned list](../topics/growth.md#growth-lead-magnet-series), [Closer to the dollars, more money](../topics/business.md#biz-closer-to-dollars), [Bio in three lines](../topics/growth.md#growth-bio-three-lines), [Lead-magnet CTA over a recap strip](../topics/growth.md#l11-lead-magnet-recap-cta) · sources L07, L08, L05

## Mixing
Briar's weekly lead magnet mixes keyword and owned list (comment, then email). Give-all-plus-extra mixes anti-CTA trust with a keyword. Share and conversation CTAs can sit on reels that sell nothing.

## Rule of thumb
Comments and leads: keyword DM. Trust and saves: anti-CTA. Meaningful engagement: conversation. Reach: share CTA. Sales: owned list.
